notes.title: Testing Build Updated to 1.18.5!
notes.content:
Hello again everyone!

Testing Build of the game has been updated to 1.18.5. Key features of this build are a revised naming system, paintable accessories and tires, more paint options, changes to the demographics system, demographics wants are now reflected in the importance stars, and a design pace system which allows you to reduce costs and employees at the expense of completion time when developing vehicle and components (the inverse is also true.)

[strike]There is an issue with the paints in Linux. I am currently working on that and hopefully I'll be able to resolve it shortly.[/strike] Also some accessories are not paintable. These will be fixed at a later date.


If you are not on Testing Build but would like to try it out, or if you're on Testing Build and want to continue your 1.18.4 save games, please see our guide on how to switch builds of the game: http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594


Work on 1.18.6 has already begun a few days ago. Its focus is improvements to the GUI system. Fixing small quarks, adding in tabbing and escape support, and many other small changes which should improve the GUI functionality. 



1.18.5 change log:
-Added Help Boxes to Light/Accessory Controls in RND and Resized GUI
-Reversed Manufacturing Requirement star in RnD View.
-Autosaves are now specific to save games. (Autosave_filename)
-Fixed bug in bore/stroke when switching engine layout.
-Fixed crash bugs when loading save games with different languages
-Expanded on unable to load game errors.
-Changed Automatic naming of Components.
-Changed Vehicle/Project naming system. No more cars named "Grandma Pants"
-Some accessories, parts, and tires can now be painted.
-Accessories and vehicle are automatically painted when created
-Accessory painting now works on mirrored accessories.
-5000 new vehicle names that have been vetted. (More may come in the future.)
-Added 218 new paints
-8 Shades of glass
-50 something leathers, plastics, and fabrics paints.
-3 different types of metal paints.
-Changed paint display layout system.
-Fixed bug that had $0 sales price displayed when viewing competition. (This was pushed as a hotfix in 1.18.4)
-Improved/adjusted demographics code and effect on vehicle sales.
-Selecting a demographic now adjust the importance sliders when designing a vehicle in advance mode.
-Selecting a demographic now boosts or decreases certain vehicle ratings as your designers cater more to the selected demo.
-Added a new development pace slider system to vehicle and components.
-Fixed Blank Vehicle Marque bug (Should fix other bugs as well)
-Fixed clone vehicle demographic's bug
-Adjusted engine ratings decline rates
-Fixed overlapping buttons when you click Tires & Accessories after placing an accessory.
-Adjusted lighting in RnD.
-Added in 3 more shadow types. If you wish to use the newer, better looking shadows, adjust them in the settings.
-Modify Engine now effects smoothness.
-Gearbox smoothness/useability is now displayed in Assisted and Advance.
-Modify Gearbox now effects smoothness and useability.
-Fixed tire and body parts selection bug that allowed for selection of parts not in view.
-Internally components have been broken up into their own tables. This should improve performance somewhat.
-Drivetrain layouts now effect max support engine size.
-Fixed incorrect vehicle type winning awards bug.
-Adjusted branch build costs
-Adjusted design pace's effects on RnD time, budget, and maximum number of employees (This still needs tweaking.)
-Reduced starting funds as things are now cheaper in early years. (This may still need tweaking.)
-Fixed bug with missing marque when switching to advance designer from assisted designer.
-Fixed new model year/new trim exploit bug.
-Removed Trim/Model year bonuses if design reqs of new vehicle exceed 15 rating points.

notes.title: Update 1.18.4!
notes.content:
Evening everyone. 

1.18.4 has been set live for Default Build of the game. If you wish to continue playing your 1.18 save games please switch to Stable Build. For instructions on how to switch versions see: http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594&pid=6237#pid6237

The plan was to update the Default Build when 1.19 was completed. However enough time has passed since the last update, 1.19 is still a month or two away, and 1.18.4 implements most of the major features and bug fixes for 1.19.  I believe this is a good time to do it.

The major feature of 1.19 was the Districting System. This has been fully implemented for 1.18.4. We've also implemented a heavily suggested change to the gameplay by moving shipping distances to the branches instead of factories.

We've also added in some new artwork, implemented/fixed 104 tickets (To put it in prospective 1.18 was only 67 tickets.) Added some turn time improvements, and improved some of the exploitable gameplay.

There is still much more to do for 1.19. Mostly in relation to cleaning up the GUI, improving scroll and click functionality, and adding hot keys. And a few other minor features. 

The Mac Port has reached Open Beta. The link has not been publicly released yet however. My publisher has asked me to hold it for a few days. (Also gives me some time to fix a couple of things.) Expect an announcement sometime in September with the links, and a release to steam with 1.19! :)


For a changelog of 1.18.4 see: http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2647&pid=6575#pid6575

Thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Testing Build 1.18.2
notes.content:
We've updated testing to 1.18.2. In this build there are quite a few bug fixes, some rebalancing, and lots of optimization fixes. I believe the game is running a bit faster now, but also maybe a little too hard (sales seem low in early years at least.)

In other news, Google Translation service is acting up again. I have attempted to install Pootle translation on our old dated CentOS 5 server. I ended up crashing the machine for a few hours last night! :) I will be buying a new vps to handle the new translation system. So look forward to that over the coming days.


1.18.3 will focus mainly on the last remaining features of the Districting system. There will be a few bug fixes sprinkled in as well. It should be a quick jump from 1.18.3 to 1.18.4 unless there are tons of submitted bugs this time. 1.18.4 will clean up a few more things and add a few minor features (such as accessory painting) at which point we'll update all builds of the game. 



Anyhoo, Enjoy!

Change Log:
-Vehicle Quality is now twice as important when calculating buyer's rating.
-Vehicle Quality decreases the margin penalty when you try to charge extremely high margins on a vehicle.
-Vehicle Quality now directly effects super high end vehicle sales numbers.
-Tweaked vehicle's sales price effect and increased buyer's rating importance over sale price for higher "wealth" type vehicles such as luxury or supercars.
-Top Speed now directly effects buying population. If you're selling 0mph/0kph vehicles you will get 0 sales!
-Lowered the expected Top Speed for buying population.
-Lowered sales price/unit costs effect on year end awards to a maximum of 20%.
-Fixed "Fire" effect on union strikes
-Made firing during strikes lower all department moral by 20%
-Lost contracts now notify you who won and how much better their bid was quantified by a percentage.
-Top speed added to view vehicle in RnD, Vehicle Image given stars, rearranged a few listings.
-Merged memos that often repeat into one memo. Removed Profits/Loss/Interest memos.
-Fixed death year bug in engine cylinders, fuel types, induction systems, and value types.
-Fixed bug in Fiscal-Stock Report that broke the reports system if you did not own any stocks.
-Tweaked tutorials to show shipping distance in branch instead of factory system.
-Fixed a couple of bugs in branch level shipping distance
-Fixed bug with new vehicles not inheriting branch level shipping distance
-Fixed number of bugs in branch level shipping distance for districts.
-Fixed Linux Unicode file save loading crash
-Fixed Belgium per capita growth rates between 1930 and 1980
-Added 6 Hood scoops
-Added 14 Rear Wings, Fins, and Lips
-Added 12 Front Bumpers
-Added 12 Rear Bumpers
-Vehicles and components can not have duplicate names now. (For vehicles this is Year Make Model Trim names.)
-Awards are now limited to vehicles being sold in the region.
-Fixed Gearbox redesign unable to select gears bug.
-Fixed Redesign component name bug.
-Fixed Idle Branches not firing employees.
-Possible fix to "district" button crash after seeing selection boxes around cities during previous turns.
-Fixed Estimated Shipping Distance Demand for Districts bug that was caused by counting branches multiple times in the district.
-Few more optimizations to squeeze a little more performance out of turn times. 
-Autoproduction takes over branch shipping distance system. Removed GUI options when Autoproduction is enabled.
-Fixed bug in very poor counties that allow them to have $0 labor.

notes.title: Testing Build Updated to 1.18.1!
notes.content:
The [b]Testing Build[/b] for GearCity has been updated to 1.18.1. If you are not on the [b]Testing Build[/b] you will not notice any changes to your game. If you wish to switch to [b]Testing[/b] but do not know how, please see my tutorial: http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594&pid=6237#pid6237

Please note, Testing build is just that. Testing. There may be more bugs than normal, however typically I fix more bugs than I make! :)


So what did we do?
1.18.1 implements the first phase of the new Districting system. This system allows you to manage multiple factories and branches as if they're one single factory or branch. We have premade districts based on countries and continents.  As well a system that will allow you to create custom districts. (Including a drag selection tool to select multiple cities at once.) Currently this system is only available in the world map. I do believe district factories and branches are finished feature wise, however I would still like your feedback before I implement District Marketing and port the system to the Mega Menu. Check out the feedback thread here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/530646715641797319/

We've also moved shipping distances from production lines to branch distribution. This gives you the player better control over the shipping distances per vehicle at a location. While this may make a little more micromanaging we have implemented a few things to help this out. Shipping distances can now be set branch wide and all new vehicles will inherit that distance. You can also lock individual shipping distances if you wish to make minor adjustments while using branch shipping as a whole. The new district system has also been integrated into shipping. You can now limit vehicle shipping from a specific district. The specific district settings will override shipping distances and only pull vehicles from the set district. Also with the District System as a whole, you can manage multiple branches's shipping districts and distances as if they're one. As you can tell by the text, lots of options.

There has been some minor cosmetic changes to World Map GUI, more is coming as we progress through 1.19.

Dealerships have become much more important. I've revised the dealership system to increase individual population pools (not shared with competition.) I've also increase the growth rates and maximum amounts. So when building branches, you may want to maximize that Dealership Relations slider so that your dealer networks grow stronger! :)

I think that covers most of the large stuff, complete change log is below.

I got to play test the game for the last 2 days. The new district system in my biased opinion is awesome. It does however show some issues we're having with turn performance (since very large companies are much easier to manage now.) 

So 1.18.2 will be a slight deviation. I am going to work on bugs, minor features, and optimizations that have been submitted to me in the last few months. My list has been building up. This should only be 2-3weeks worth of work. With 1.18.3 I'll move back to finishing what I have left of the district system and feedback you folks have given me on the system. At that point I will probably update everyone before moving on to other features I have slated for 1.19.

(On a side note, Mac OSX port is almost finished, 99% sure it'll be good to go for 1.19!!! May have an open beta for it sometime in the next month or so.)

That sums it up. Enjoy!

Change Log
------------------------------------------------
-Removed 16-bit color options
-Removed 800 x 640 and smaller resolutions
-Fixed broken video settings crash when switching from OpenGL to DirectX
-Factory Production Lines list now automatically sorts by Lines used, Local Reserves, then Global Reserves.
-Added vehicle quality information and rate change to the production lines window (This will allow you to see the effects settings a production line to quality has.)
-Added a warning message for worn, war, and low moral effect on production output. This message will show your effected output due to these factors.
-Adjusted production output to allow 1 vehicle per month.
-You can now directly type in how many vehicles you want to produce, the game will adjust the sliders for you.
-Fixed Dublin WW2 bug.
-Fixed bug in base vehicle type filters in factory production window.
-Moved Factory Shipping Distance to Branch Distribution.
-District Factory View (Allows you to view all factories info in a selected district)
-District Factory Build (Builds a Factory in every selected city in the district that does not have a factory)
-District Factory Recondition (retool) (Retools every factory in the selected district.)
-District Factory Upgrading (Upgrade all factories in selected District)
-District Factory Resizing (Resize all factories in selected District)
-District Factory Closing (Close all factories in selected District)
-District Production (Manage production lines, quality sliders, for all factories selected in the district.)
-Branch View Redesigned
-Minor changes to Branch Build/Redesigned
-Removed retool slider from Branch Retool.
-Minor changes to Branch Close
-Branch view automatically comes up when selecting a branch
-Branch build automatically comes up when selecting a city without a branch
-Maximum Dealerships increased.
-Dealership franchises rates increased.
-Optimized dealership calculations
-Dealerships now effect buying population pool for individual vehicles.
-Merged Avaliable and Selected Vehicle Branch Lists
-Removed Priority system from game
-Expanded Competition list in distro GUI
-Redesigned buttons and layout in distro GUI
-Added shipping slider to branch distro
-Added shipping lock system to prevent changes to locked shipping distances
-Added a "Unit Manufacturing Costs" to side panel, showing the cost of a unit without including corporate expenses.
-Reworded the corporate expense side panel amount in distro, since it was confusing some people.
-Added estimated units in shipping range
-Factories now highlight orange when setting shipping distance.
-Shipping Distance panel now shows how many vehicles are being produced and reserved inside shipping radius
-Added shipping distance, shipping lock, and district lock to distro side panel
-Ported all distro changes to Mega Menu
-Added a branch shipping distance system. This changes the shipping distance for ALL vehicles at a branch unless they are shipping distance locked.
-District Branch View
-District Branch Build
-District Branch Redesign
-District Branch Retool
-District Branch Close
-District Branch Distribution.
-District Branch Shipping.
-Ship from District system.
-Create your own custom districts
-Multicity selection tool for creating districts. (click and drag)
-Deleting custom districts
-Editing custom districts.

While this may make a little more micromanaging we have implemented a few things to help this out. Shipping distances can now be set branch wide and all new vehicles will inherit that distance. You can also lock individual shipping distances if you wish to make minor adjustments while using branch shipping as a whole. The new district system has also been integrated into shipping. You can now limit vehicle shipping from a specific district. The specific district settings will override shipping distances and only pull vehicles from the set district. Also with the District System as a whole, you can manage multiple branches's shipping districts and distances as if they're one. As you can tell by the text, lots of options.

There has been some minor cosmetic changes to World Map GUI, more is coming as we progress through 1.19.

Dealerships have become much more important. I've revised the dealership system to increase individual population pools (not shared with competition.) I've also increase the growth rates and maximum amounts. So when building branches, you may want to maximize that Dealership Relations slider so that your dealer networks grow stronger! :)

I think that covers most of the large stuff, complete change log is below.

I got to play test the game for the last 2 days. The new district system in my biased opinion is awesome. It does however show some issues we're having with turn performance (since very large companies are much easier to manage now.) 

So 1.18.2 will be a slight deviation. I am going to work on bugs, minor features, and optimizations that have been submitted to me in the last few months. My list has been building up. This should only be 2-3weeks worth of work. With 1.18.3 I'll move back to finishing what I have left of the district system and feedback you folks have given me on the system. At that point I will probably update everyone before moving on to other features I have slated for 1.19.

(On a side note, Mac OSX port is almost finished, 99% sure it'll be good to go for 1.19!!! May have an open beta for it sometime in the next month or so.)

That sums it up. Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.18 Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Another Friday, Another Hotfix!

This is probably the last hotfix for 1.18 series unless some major bugs are found this weekend. I will start on save game breaking features (Districting/Grouping Management System!!!) for the 1.18.1 build sometime next week. 

On another note, I will not be programming this weekend. I will still be checking the forums and emails for tech support issues. My reply time may be slower than normal however, sorry for any inconveniences. 

Thank you all again, and enjoy!

Change Log:
-Fixed bug causing high engine smoothness ratings, thus creating high luxury and dependability ratings for AI and player vehicles.
-Adjusted suggested vehicle sales price to use the total estimated costs analysis
-Changes a few panels into windows so they can not be overlapped by other windows when opening.
-Reversed manufacturing requirement stars in modification window.
-Improved autoproduction first turn production
-Improved autoproduction assessment. (This means that the AI and the player should not have months where they sell out of vehicles because autoproduction does not restart production. Also autoproduction should more tightly control inventories.) 
-Moved hardcoded '$' symbols to the localization file (So their placement can be changed in translations, and possibly in the future, modded to other currencies.)
-Increased design time with exponential slider penalty.
-Fixed multiple repeat major events to cities during total war. (Destruction in Brussels during WW1 will only happen once for example.)
-Removed red color from construction costs on the world map
-Added zoom to car designer.
-Fixed research time bug when modifying a new model year.
-Fixed research time bug when making a new trim.
-Adjusted cost decay valves to reduce lower unit costs decay rates.
-Production Unoptimized memo will only fire once per turn.
-Fixed Chassis weight unit costs bug
-Fixed Specific Vehicle Type Rating decline bug.
-Fixed a bug in ratings change display in RnD when there is no gains.
-Fixed bug in image system that caused it to be increaslingly difficult to raise image ratings.
-Fixed bug in "Save As" text box that allowed you to put unsupported characters into the names thus breaking the saves.
-AI now fires branch and marketing workers in cities that are at war.
-Reduced Recall failure effects on Image ratings.
-Fixed roughly 15 textures that could cause video card drivers to crash over time.

notes.title: 1.18 Released to Default Branch!
notes.content:
1.18 has been released to the Default branch. If you still wish to play 1.17 save games, you can switch to stable branch at anytime. Instructions are [url=http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594]here[/url]

1.18 was a long time coming. I blew the original estimated dates mainly because I wanted to get rid of some of the GUI complaints about the game. This was a lot of unscheduled work.  In 1.18 a vast amount of the GUI has been rewritten in the RnD department. There are still some quarks here and there but most will find that it is much easier to use.

We've also added many new features, fixed a few old ones, and adjusted the gameplay mechanics internally somewhat. There is now much more visible information in the RnD department.


1.19 will focus mainly on factories, branches, production, and selling. As well as a makeover of the world map GUI. We will follow the same set up as 1.18 with minor versions being released in Testing branch and only updating the main branch of the game with major versions releases.

Anyhoo Enjoy! And please if you have any question, comments, or issues, feel free to get ahold of me via Email, Forums, or even chat message. I don't mind.

notes.title: 1.18 Released to Default Branch!
notes.content:
1.18 has been released to the Default branch. If you still wish to play 1.17 save games, you can switch to stable branch at anytime. Instructions are [url=http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594]here[/url]

1.18 was a long time coming. I blew the original estimated dates mainly because I wanted to get rid of some of the GUI complaints about the game. This was a lot of unscheduled work.  In 1.18 a vast amount of the GUI has been rewritten in the RnD department. There are still some quarks here and there but most will find that it is much easier to use.

We've also added many new features, fixed a few old ones, and adjusted the gameplay mechanics internally somewhat. There is now much more visible information in the RnD department.


1.19 will focus mainly on factories, branches, production, and selling. As well as a makeover of the world map GUI. We will follow the same set up as 1.18 with minor versions being released in Testing branch and only updating the main branch of the game with major versions releases.

Anyhoo Enjoy! And please if you have any question, comments, or issues, feel free to get ahold of me via Email, Forums, or even chat message. I don't mind.

1.18 Change Log:
-------------------------------------------------
It's too long to post, visit here:  http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/620700960970022451/

tags.feature: - We've also added many new features

tags.bug: - fixed a few old ones

tags.balance_change: - adjusted the gameplay mechanics internally somewhat

notes.title: Hotfix #2 released to "Testing Branch"
notes.content:
Hello again everyone,
We've released a second hotfix to the "Testing Branch" for 1.17.8.

You must be using the "Testing Branch" in order to receive this update. For information on how to switch builds [url=http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594&pid=6237#pid6237]click here.[/url]


This patch includes:
-Fixed Wording for "Select Engine" in gearbox prototyping.
-Fixed missing combo box data in advance designer when switching from assisted.
-Adjusted player and AI component selection code.
-Slightly decreased vehicle unit costs
-Lowered starting design skills
-Fixed Trim/NewModel year timing bug
-Adjusted fuel code to account for number of gears more.
-Added an optimization warning message if you can not improve your fuel consumption anymore with designed engine.
-Fixed Label resetting bug for prototyping.
-Fixed possible crash in prototyping. 


I will probably switch back to features and GUI redesign Monday evening. Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.17.8 Released to "Testing Branch"
notes.content:
Hello again everyone! 1.17.8 has been released to "Testing Branch." [b]You must be on the "Testing Branch" in order to get this update.[/b] For instructions on how to switch builds [url=http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594&pid=6237#pid6237] click here.[/url]

1.17.8 includes many changes to the RnD GUI along with major overhauls of the Modification and Trimming systems. 1.18 is still running behind because I have done more to the GUI than I originally planned. We still have a number of features to get to before 1.18 can be finished. These include a redesign of the licensing system. New view component/vehicle GUI and a visible tech tree for RnD.

I can guarantee a 1.18 release for next month. I may push some lesser important 1.18 tickets to other builds in order to get it out. In the future I will try not to schedule so much stuff for one major version. I believe 1.18 was too large! :)

Anyway, next couple of days I will work on minor bug fixes, I'll try to release these as hotfixes until I get some save game changes, then we'll go back to closed development until 1.18 is ready to ship out!

notes.title: 1.17.5 Released in "Testing" Branch.
notes.content:
1.17.5 has been released to "Testing" branch.  For Windows users you must opt-in. If you do not know how to change branches I made a little [url=http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2594]tutroial here[/url]

For Linux users this is a mandatory update. It fixes many issues we had with windowing, mouse, and keyboard input. 

I advise everyone to use the hardware mouse mode. It significantly improves input.

Feedback is greatly appreciated.

Anyhoo I will continue working on the 1.18 release which is mostly feature fixes and GUI adjustments in the RnD. I'm roughly 52% finished, so if the last 50% was any indication, mid-march would be the release goal.

Change Log:
-Redesigned vehicle ratings importance system
-AI component selection redesign
-AI slider behaviors redesigned
-Consumer AI ratings importance redesign
-Assisted Designer Component selection redesign
-Assisted Designer sliders settings redesigned
-Sub-component popularity index
-Manual Popularity Change
-Dynamic Fuel Popularity
-Component popularity random events now added,
-Consumers now take into consideration fuel type when buying a vehicle.
-Bought a refurbed MacMini (I'll start the Mac port soon as I get it.)
-Specific Vehicle Type Rating.
-Fixed AI factory production over maximum line limits (Should also fix the same issue with Auto Production tool.)
-Added tax expenses to two fiscal expense reports
-Fixed total expenses in two fiscal reports that had tax payments off set from actual payment dates.
-Fixed bug in office "profits" label in upper left hand screen which did include interest generated from money in bank savings account.
-Fixed Save Body bug in which the Warning label prevented the user from changing the name.
-Added a "Disable Banking Fees" Advance Game switch.
-Freed the report names so after you delete a report, you can reuse the name.
-Fixed bug in the end turn report system that didn't properly get the report information when you hit the next button.
-Fixed the bug in the vehicle demands report. If you had a vehicle that was being designed, the text would cut off from the rest of the report.
-Removed the add to end report button on reports that can not be added to the end turn reports.
-Fixed drag coefficient bug on models that have an open roof.
-Fixed a bug in the branch reports that did not reset sales per city. Thus giving too high of a sales figure.
-Cleaned up a number of text issues. (Thanks Jose!)
-Fixed bug in reserve shipping distance inheritance. You can also now change the shipping distances of any vehicles in reserve.
-Fixed bug in contract reports system that displayed contracts that were no longer active.
-Fixed bug in the clone vehicle sliders system.
-Fixed parts placement bug where if you rotated the camera to the other side of the design room, placed parts would be flipped.
-Fixed 2 possible crash points with decal flipping
-Design sliders exponential expenses
-Balanced Designed Costs
-Balanced Unit Costs
-Hypercar Design/Unit Costs penalty
-Fixed lower vehicle costs than components bug.
-RnD Windows automatically Tile
-RnD upper drop down panels now open over top of any other opened windows.
-Drivetrain stat balancing
-Engine Smoothness/Noise Rating
-Engine SubComponents Smoothness Ratings
-Valvetrains
-10 Valvetrain layouts
-SDL window mode (LINUX)
-Fuel and Induction system balancing
-Three new induction types, Turbos broken down into 10 "levels."
-6 New engine layouts
-3 New fuel types (5 Generations of Electric power)
-2 new cylinder type
-Modification to Bore/Stroke system
-Inversed design/manufacturing requirement stars
-Engine Power and Engine Fuel ratings now use specs
-Stopped Engine Fuel ratings decrease
-Boost Induction systems fuel economy.
-Removed Gearfor
-Reverse gear checkbox.
-Gearbox Maximum Torque Input
-Gearbox Comfort/Smoothness Rating
-4 New Transmission Types
-Improved Aerodynamic Drag calculations
-Vehicle Specs window in body designer.
-Car Stats balancing
-Vehicle Fuel, Power, Cargo stats are now directly from specs and do not decrease.
-Vehicle Performance stats now use more specs.
-Increased Contract Cargo requirements slightly. (Vehicles are larger now)
-Fixed few minor bugs in view contract rnd GUI, will be getting a make over later.
-Combined City and Highway fuel mileage into one rating called "Combined" (Will make it easier to user selected units in the future.)
-Fixed bug in advance gearbox designer which zeroed out the number of selected gears if you change gearbox type while in the sliders mode.
-Tweaked assisted designer results for engines and gearboxes.
-Fixed a couple of bugs introduced by new features.

notes.title: Minor Linux Input Hotfix
notes.content:
We've had a few issues with the input system in Linux lately.

As stated twice in the 1.18 progress thread, my Linux time will be devoted to fixing issues with OIS to improve input for *nix users. 

For this minor hotpatch, I've reenabled mouse grabbing in software mode and have fixed a warp issue.

If you are playing in Windowed mode, please run the game at a lower resolution than your desktop. Some desktop environments such as Unity will cause issues with mouse positioning. There also may be clipping related issues due to X11 not warping the mouse. (Neither of which will be an issue if you run the window at a lower resolution.)

***EDIT I pushed another patch fixing OIS wrap even more. Full screen window mode works fine now on xfce and fvwm-crystal, however mouse is off set on Unity, so the same above may apply for some DE's***

Full screen users should not have this problem. Although I can not test it on all DE's and all versions of X. If you experience issues please report them in our bugs forum.

If you have mouse clicking problems. Please lower your mouse sensitivity settings. This normally will resolve the issue.

Please note the keyboard does not work in Hardware Mouse mode. Your mouse will also be off set by the amount of window decoration your DE applies to the window.



On another note. If I can not get OIS to work well enough over the coming weeks, then I'll port the software to SDL2. There are issues with doing this however, which is why it has not been done as many of you have suggested.

notes.title: 1.17 Released!
notes.content:
Good morning everyone, 

We've released 1.17 this morning to the Default (None) branch on Steam. We've also upgraded the Stable branch to 1.16.5 and the Legacy branch to 1.16.1.  (So if you want to play your older saves, change to those branches.) The current plan is not to have any minor versions for this build, only hotfixes. So feel free to play a long/full game as the next save game breaking patch will likely by a month or so away.

1.17 saw many changes to the game. The big ones included Unicode and foreign language support, military and fleet contracting, redesigned magazine and mega menu, and an action memo system. We've also took care of a good number of bugs and implemented a [b]Hardware Accelerated Mouse[/b] (which you can enable in the settings.)

For a complete change log for 1.17 see this thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/613937306725305473/


Since 1.16.5 we implemented the Action Memo system. Which currently has 3 actions, one for war, one for near bankruptcy, and the last one for recalls (this one also has a class action lawsuit follow up.) We'll be adding more actions over time. We also fixed a memory leak issue when designing cars, enabled a frame limiter for people who have broken vsync, and implemented a hardware mouse for those who have mouse speed issues. For a change log since 1.16.5, see the bottom of this announcement.


So what about 1.18? Over the course of 1.17 I fixed my trac (ticketing system) and started to compile a giant list of user feedback and suggestions. (You can view this list here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/617320628374538453/) As you can see 1.18 deals mainly with all the suggestions and my own ideas for the RnD department and Consumer AI. We'll be adding new ratings, presenting important information to you better, and Improving the AI's ability to design components and vehicles. This should significantly improve both the user's gameplay and the AI's. It'll also probably add an extra layer of awesomeness to the game. So social life beware! :D

As mentioned in the opening paragraph, I'll be moving back to the OpenBeta style of releases. This means a 4-6 week major build patch instead of the current weekly/bi-weekly minor build patches. We're moving back to this because the game has stabilized quite a bit over the last 6 months. So I should avoid breaking your save games when possible. Having massive patches instead of a bunch of weekly minor ones is a better way to go. If you're worried about my work productivity, don't be, follow my progress in the 1.18 Progress thread on the forums! 

If any major bugs come around during 1.17, I have a separate fork to hot patch the game without breaking save files. ETA for 1.18 is going to be early/mid February. 

Enjoy the game, and happy new year!

Change Log 1.16.5->1.17
----------------------------
-Clone Branch now can delete vehicles
-Implemented a hard frame limiter for video cards that can't handle vsync. Game should run between 30-35fps. (Yes I know 30 is hated, but ask your self, do slider slide prettier at 60 fps?)
-Fixed GearCity Monthly Memo Bug again (For good this time)
-Fixed Sofia wrong country bug.
-Added model years to 3 or 4 premade reports.
-Action Memo System
-Recall Action
-Defective Vehicles Class Action Lawsuit
-Going Bankrupt Action Memo
-Engine Contract Factory Assignment.
-22 New car models
-Hardware Accelerated Mouse
-Game Loading Bug (LINUX)
-Fixed Incorrect units (inches instead of mm) in the Magazine.
-Reduced Cargo Requirements for contracts more.
-Mega Menu arrows now cycle through factory or branches depending on which you have open.
-Fixed Linux mouse bug when running in window mode at the same resolution as your desktop.

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've pushed 1.16.5 live to the Default branch of the game.

I know I said 1.16.5 would actually be the 1.17 build, but we did a lot of work and I'm sure you guys want to use some of the cool new features! So I decided to push this as a patch before I start working on things that will break save games (again.) It's been too long for a 1.16.4.2 hot patch, thus 1.16.5 was born.

So what's new about this build? 

The main thing is a redesigned MegaMenu. There is one or two extra clicks to get to the screen you want, however with the extra room we can now pack it with more features! :) We've also included some information to help you with your vehicle pricing/inventory management on the side of both the World Map windows and mega menu.

A full Change log can be found at the bottom.


So the next build will be 1.17, it will break your save games, and there isn't much to do in it outside of one feature and content for that feature. The main focus will be the Action Memo system. If all goes well, it'll be ready before the end of the year.

As always, if you have any questions, comments, or problems feel free to contact me anywhere or anyhow, I'm happy to help! :)

Enjoy!~ And stay tuning! 

1.16.5 Change Log
-------------------------------------------------------------
-Fixed Full Sized Van's Cargo ratings
-Reduced Fleet Contract's Cargo requirements by 20%
-Fixed scroll on Magazine Review's vehicle selection
-Fixed dramatic stock price increase bug.
-Reduced cash's effect on stock evaluation.
-Increased profit margin's effect on stock evaluation.
-Finished Factory MegaMenu system.
-Finished Branch MegaMenu system.
-City Info MegaMenu
-All Forms of Marketing Selection in Mega Menu.
-All forms, Apply to All Mega Menu
-Cloned Marketing Mega Menu
-Distribution and Factory production Information side panels
-Cleaned up bugs in Autotools
-Fixed factory starting health
-Recompressed paint textures in dds format.
-Fixed Repeat Music Bug outside of the office.
-Decrease Transparent Texture (Allows for label scrolling)
-Added GearCity Version to Log Files

notes.content:
Good evening everyone!

GearCity 1.16.4 has been released. It comes with major improvements to our Fleet Contracting system. I've been able to implement most of your feedback. There are still one or two things that require what I will be adding in 1.16.5 for them to work. So it's not 100% as of yet.

1.16.5 will be our last build for the 1.17 series. And it will be released as 1.17.
It should include:
-Action Memo System (You will be presented with an event and an action you can take which will effect your company.)
-Redesigned MegaMenu

Plus some fixes to the new magazine system, a couple new contracting features, and sprinkle of bug fixes here and there.

There will be a save change in this build, however for 1.18 I will be slowing down our release cycle so that some of you have more time to play your full games without having to switch to stable branch.


1.16.4 Change Log
--------------------------------
-Fixed Reflective Shaders in LINUX
-Fixed Vehicle Type Duplication bug in Assisted Designers
-Put a maximum bid amount the AI is willing to pay for contracts.
-Split the main tutorial into multiple parts in the Main Menu and Select HQ map.
-City infrastructure effects civilian contract likelihood.
-Lobbying effects chances of winning military contract bid.
-Increased Bid length by a minimum of 6 months up to a maximum increase of 9 months.
-New contracting memo now specifically shows contracts you can bid on. And contracts you can not bid on.
-Fixed memo scrolling cut off.
-Added per month values to number of units needed in contracts
-Fixed AI/Player cargo volume measurements for Liters
-Fixed cargo volume requirements for contract requests
-Added Metric and SAE units for cargo volume in the contract request.
-RnD Contracts have been renamed to Licenses
-Fleet Contracts can now be viewed in RnD Department
-Fixed list selection crash on model comparison in the Magazine.
-60 Engine Applications for Contracting.
-Engine Application effects Contracting Requirements.
-Removed Layout from Contracted Engine Requirements.
-Fixed possible endless loop condition with AI designing GearBoxes.
-Added Human Resources Tutorial
-Added Lobbying Tutorial
-Finished this round of balancing to the contracts (may have to do a little more work to the components.xml file)
-Increased mouse sensitivity (Should improve gameplay on laptops)
-Replaced all the hitboxes with properly fitting hit boxes.
-Fixed a number of minor sqlite exceptions.
-Fixed window open highlighting bug in Office
-Fixed Class Challenge using wrong vehicles.
-Fixed Class Challenge disappearing vehicles in results.
-Class Challenge columns automatically adjust height
-Replaced all acceleration 0's with "Too Slow" or "Not Applicable"
-All player vehicles in distribution now display in reviews"

notes.content:
1.16.3 has been launched!

This build features an all new redesigned magazine with a whole bunch of new articles. A few things in it are not complete, such as the Public Polling, Letters to the Editor, and the End of the Year Awards formatting. We'll knock those three out as soon as we get all that we need for them.

This build also includes a Russian translation. It is partially complete and some texts have issues fitting inside the GUI. If you use the translated file, PLEASE report any crashing bugs to us! If all goes well we will open up our translation system to the community so that we can get other languages into the game! :)


There was also a number of minor bug fixes and balancing in this build. The most notable would be fixes to mouse lag issues. We found that the glow compositors is what was causing the GUI to lag at higher resolutions. As such I have disabled the glow compositors. You can re-enable them in the Settings windows from the main menu. 

As of right now only the hitboxes will highlight. Which is ugly. This is only temporary. We will replace these hitbox with much better defined shapes in a hot patch sometime this week. 

So what about 1.16.4? The coming up build will mainly focus on your feedback and suggestions on the contracting system. There is a whole bunch of little things we need to improve in this system before we can continue with anything else. Of course, I'll take care of major and easy bugs as they popup.

Change Log:

-Table of Contents page for magazine
-Linux Build now has Sound/Music!
-Editor's Message in magazine
-Some Magazine advertisements.
-New vehicle translation system
-Integrated reviews into localization file
-New vehicle review magazine gui.
-Class Challenge Magazine article.
-Fixed WW2 Germany bug again.
-New Model Comparison Magazine article.
-Finished Marque Catalog Tool
-Fixed Manual hiring of researching projects when Research teams are not activated.
-Fixed Language loading in LINUX
-Fixed Load Game Timestamps in LINUX
-Fixed loading premade vehicles in LINUX
-Added more vehicle reviews
-Finished redesign of AI News.
-Automotive Superlatives article in magazine.
-Fixed Mouse Lag Bug
-Fixed Soviet Minsk bug.
-Year End Car Awards.
-Mouse Glow Compositor toggle in settings.
-Non-Compositor mouse over objects, (For when compositors are turned off)
-Fixed San Marino war bug
-Fixed Passenger reduction bug
-Adjusted retooling cost to fit the new lengthen time periods between retooling.
-Added page turning/table of contents buttons to Magazine
-Adjusted some gui widths for russian text
-1.16.3 Russian language file added. (83% translated, some text too long.)

notes.content:
Hello again everyone. 

I pushed a hot fix this evening to fix 2 or 3 breaking bugs we had in our new contract system. I would of normally held off until 1.16.3 for this patch, however I felt that the fixes were important enough to gameplay to go ahead and push them.

That being said, I was in the process of redesigning the magazine. Because of this hot patch, I have [b]disabled the magazine until 1.16.3 is out.[/b] Sorry for the inconvenience.  

Here is the fixes included in the patch:
+Fixed division by zero crash in contracting sales book
+Fixed contracts that require less than 1 unit per month
+Fixed Vertical Line spacing issue for mono fonts in Linux
+Fixed civilian fleet contracting engine size bug.

notes.content:
1.16.2 has been published to the Default branch. This build mainly focused on our new Military and Civilian Fleet Contracting system. Since this is our first release for the new system, your feedback is greatly appreciated. Feel free to post in this thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/613940477764758894/ on steam or on our official forums here: http://www.ventdev.com/forums/showthread.php?tid=2425

There were also a bunch of minor bug fixes, gui changes, and font changes in this build.

The Linux build may have a minor issue of text clipping in some selectable lists and combo boxes. I plan on investigating the issue this weekend. 

Stable build has been upgraded to 1.16.1 as there should be no save game differences between the previous Stable.


[b]Contracting Directions[/b]
[list]
[*]Every Quarter (turns: 3/6/9/12) New contracts will generate.
[*]Check the phone on the office desk under contracts to see if you have any contracts you can bid on
[*]Select component you wish to submit to the bid.
[*]Submit the bid
[*]Wait for the deadline to pass, you will recieve a memo if you have been selected.
[*]To check current contracts, click the Sales Book on the desk, then select contracts
[*]Contracted Vehicles will be pulled automatically before sales to branches.
[*]During war time, you can produce military contracted vehicles/engines for your HQ country in any factories located in your HQ country.
[/list] 

So what to look forward to? 1.16.3 will focus on redoing the magazine/reviews system, and 1.16.4 will be implementing the new action memo system and whatever feedback we get for contracting.

-Fixed a number of clipping issues with large font GUI
-Fixed Marketing Report bug
-Fixed Factory Resize Information/Blocker
-Fixed Crash with Text Inputs

-Peace Time Military Contracting
-Civilian Fleet/Component Contracting

-Contracting Filtering
-Added details to Contracting Selection screen
-Switched fonts to DejaVu (Which is also cross language as well!)
-Fixed bug in config files which has been causing recent crashes for people who haven't played in a while.
-Player bid submission
-AI bid submission
-AI granting bid contract
-Fixed a button texture wrap bug
-Possible crash fixes to low end intel video cards due to GUI textures.
-Automated Contract Shipping for players and AI.
-Breach of contract penalties.
-Revenues generated from contract sales.
-Reorganized Revenue and Expense panels in salesbook
-"Revenues Generated by Contracts" list information in Revenues Panel.
-Contracts panel in sales book now displays current contracts you have and information about them.
-Military Contracts production enabled during war
-Contracting Nanny Messages and Memos
-Fixed AI cargo spec bug
-Fixed textbox overlap bugs
-Fixed research time rounding bug
-Added Scroll Bar to memos
-Factories automatically idle when when their host countries go to war. The exception is factories in your HQ country.
-You can no longer assign or adjust production in factories outside your HQ country during war.
-Updated video setting changer program (was causing crashes because it was lacking new features)

notes.title: Linux Client Released!
notes.content:
Tired of always winning? Sick of those easy cartoonish tycoon games
with unrealistic economics?  Have you ever wanted to manage your own
car company?  Do you play games on Linux?

Well friend, I have great news for you! GearCity has been released for Linux!

GearCity is the economic business simulator that put you in charge of
an automobile manufacturer. Play 120 years of automotive history with
realistic economic data and simulations.

This release brings our Linux client up to par with our Windows release--
all major features from the Windows release are included. We'll try to
maintain same day simultaneous releases for future updates.

The current build does have a few Linux specific issues which will be
addressed over time:
[list]
[*]32-bit binary. [i](This requires Multi-arch support)[/i]
[*]Music is disabled
[*]Charts disabled [i](Can be enabled by installing 32bit libs, see
InstallDirections.txt in parent directory for directions)[/i]
[*]Loading pre-made vehicles is disabled
[*]No dates on load save games
[*]Materials not showing up correctly on vehicles on some video cards
[/list]

Try the free demo on our site: http://www.gearcity.info/
[i]For the demo you will have to install your own libs. Instructions are
written in the file "UbuntuDirections.txt" in the top level directory.[/i]

Questions? Comments? Feedback? Feel free to ask!

This release brings our Linux client up to par with our Windows release-- all major features from the Windows release are included.

notes.content:
1.16.1 has been released.

This build is mainly internal changes to our localization system. This will make translations to other languages much easier to do. We're currently working on an online system using Google Translation Toolkit to do CAT. We'll release access to the community as soon as we get a work flow going with it. 

We've also included font resizing. This will allow you to increase the size of the font in the settings. Please note that larger fonts are semi-experimental at this time. There will be some places that the text does not fit. I am in the process of cleaning up these places. Gameplay should not be hampered by these instances. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

We have updated Legacy to 1.15.1, and Stable to 1.16. If you're playing older save games, you may want to drop back to one of these builds to continue your game.

The Linux build will enter Steam testing this weekend. Hopefully we'll be able to release it to the public in a week or so! :)

So what do we have planned for 1.16.2?
The main feature will be the new government and fleet contracting system. This system will also bring along the action memo system. We'll also hit up breaking bugs as they're found or reported. And fix tiny issues we have here and there as we come across them.

Thank you again, please let me know if you have questions, comments, or suggestions! And stay tuning!

1.16.1 Change Log:
-Customized font loading from localization file.
-Font resizing.
-Unicode output.
-Unicode input.
-Python Style String Formatting in Localization System.
-Fixed text comparison issues.
-Fixed double quote error in random events.
-Made memo stack glow on some random events.
-Components.xml file translatable in Localization file.

1.16.1 has been released.

This build is mainly internal changes to our localization system. This will make translations to other languages much easier to do. We're currently working on an online system using Google Translation Toolkit to do CAT. We'll release access to the community as soon as we get a work flow going with it. 

We've also included font resizing. This will allow you to increase the size of the font in the settings. Please note that larger fonts are semi-experimental at this time. There will be some places that the text does not fit. I am in the process of cleaning up these places. Gameplay should not be hampered by these instances. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

We have updated Legacy to 1.15.1, and Stable to 1.16. If you're playing older save games, you may want to drop back to one of these builds to continue your game.

The Linux build will enter Steam testing this weekend. Hopefully we'll be able to release it to the public in a week or so! :)

So what do we have planned for 1.16.2?
The main feature will be the new government and fleet contracting system. This system will also bring along the action memo system. We'll also hit up breaking bugs as they're found or reported. And fix tiny issues we have here and there as we come across them.

Thank you again, please let me know if you have questions, comments, or suggestions! And stay tuning!

notes.content:
Hello everyone, 1.16 has been released to the Default branch! Stable and Legacy branches will be updated in about 2 weeks. We're roughly 18 days late with this release. A few things slowed us down, but we made it before the end of the month. Sorry for the delays. 

1.16 focused on three major things. First was the Linux port, which has gone pretty well. We should be releasing it sometime in the month of October. (An upcoming promotional event has delayed it some, but this allows me time to work out a few of the little issues the Open Beta has shown us.) 

We also created an internal text tutorial system. I've been neglecting to make more tutorials for it because of 1.16's delay. Currently we have a base introduction tutorial, but the framework allows us to add many advance tutorials. Once I have everything smoothed out on the Linux port, I will devote at least 1-2 hours a day documenting stuff in the tutorial system.

The last major feature was a redesign of the Racing System. On the outside not much has changed, but internally it's a completely different beast. We've added more series and more interaction with your teams. There is still some minor quarks, but most of the bugs in the system have been ironed out.

Of course we also included many suggestions and fixed many bugs as always.

For a complete change log see: http://steamcommunity.com/app/285110/discussions/0/34094415738310881/

[b]So enough about the past, what about the future?[/b]

For 1.17 we plan on three major features to come out.

First is Unicode support, reformatting the text in the game to be easily translatable, hot loading of translation files (so no more editing GUI), custom font loading, custom font sizes, and a community translation web interface.  All of that means one thing. We're translating the game to multiple languages! Hopefully it will be a community driven effort. More details will come as they come.

Second will be Government/Fleet contracting. This has been a heavily requested feature as you can't really do anything during war time. Essentially your HQ government will contract Compact SUV's and Engines during war time, assuming you win bids.  Police, taxi's and many other fleets will contract out sedans, vans, etc during times of peace. Remember to grease the politician's pockets! ;) 

Last major feature will be a redesign of the Magazine system. We really need to put a lot more information in it, and fix the review system. It's horrible as it is now. So we'll do that! :)

As always, minor bug fixes and suggestions as I roll along.


*EDIT* Also uploaded a hotfix to fix save game loading.

Anyhoo, since this can effect six months of sales, I released the fix as a hot patch.

Enjoy, and sorry!

notes.content:
1.15.3 Is out. 

1.15.3 mainly focused on our new integrated tutorial system. Most of the video tutorials have been translated to this new format. As of now we only cover the basics, however we plan to add additional advance tutorials over the next few minor releases.

If you want to access these tutorials, click the help menu in the upper right hand corner and select "Enable Tutorials." It is best to start the tutorials in the Main Menu and follow the prompts.  The tutorials should be automatically enabled if you have not played the game since 1.15.1 or if you have a fresh install.

There may be a few minor issues with the tutorial system. Sorry, still working out all the kinks.


In 1.15.3 we also made some adjustments to the AI, The AI should be more difficult now, more companies will last the duration of the game. However please note this will slow down turn times. So you may wish to play with less starting AI.


Some minor fixes to the UI should improve mouse speeds in the office. I continue to do minor tweaks to this system.



With the bulk of the tutorial system solved. I will move back toward minor bugs and user suggestions for 1.15.4 and start working on the last major feature of 1.16, the new improved racing system.

No ETA on 1.15.4, but it should not be more than 2 weeks. 3 weeks max.

1.15.2 has been published to the [b]Default[/b] Branch. This build will break your save games. However if you still wish to play your old saves you can switch to 1.15.1 by using the [b]Stable[/b] branch.

To switch branches:
*In your Steam Library, right click GearCity.
*Select Properties
*Select the Betas tab
*Choose a Branch:
None -> Default Branch, 1.15.2
Stable-> 1.15.1
Legacy-> 1.14.8 


As you can tell the base of the tutorial system has been implemented. You can access a test case in the Main Menu by clicking Help in the upper right, and then selecting "Enable Tutorials". It currently does not look pretty. But the main thing is if it works or not. So please let me know. If you have any issues with the system, disable it, and it should not effect you.

For 1.15.3 I will be working more on the tutorial system. Implementing some optimization fixes to the GUI, and doing some more work on the AI. 

Linux users can expect a demo build of the game in a week or so. So stay tuned for that.

-Fixed crash in showroom when no vehicle is selected.
-Integrated Tutorial System Framework.
-HR department no longer shows unfunded research teams.
-Lobbying no longer has an immediate effect on benefits.
-Hiring in HR now longer has random employee amounts when hiring less than average wages.
-Switched position of maximum supported engine width and length as requested.
-Fixed mega menu shipping priority bug. Mega Menu shipping now defaults to "Normal"
-Are you sure function added to vehicle end production.
-New Game Settings- Removing all wars
-New Game Settings- Removing all economic fluctuations.
-New Game Settings- Start with no Factories or Branches
-New Game Settings- Start with a Loan.
-New Game Settings- Start with custom amount of money.
-Added monthly costs to factory build screen.
-Added factory completion time to mega menu.
-Tweaked player/ai effects on cities, adjusted growth rates to be closer to normal rates.
-Tweaked factory costs just a little bit more.
-Adjusted AI to take advantage of new factory system. So they don't bankrupt as quickly.
-Possible fix to the report list not displaying lines.
-Fixed "chassis is too wide for body" when loading a vehicle body.
-Adjusted vehicle length/width to match chassis wheelbase.

notes.content:
Another week, another patch.

This week I mainly focused on the Linux port and any bug fixes that come from it. I also knocked out a few minor suggestions from our main forums. The Linux port is almost complete. There are only a few minor issues left to be dealt with. I should be able to finish it hopefully by Monday. Which means we'll have a Linux Open Beta (Demo) release to test out the Linux build. So if you're a Linux user, defiantly check that out!  

Since I still have a little bit more to do on the Linux build, 1.15.2 will mainly be bug fixes and minor suggestions. 1.15.3 I'll start working on the integrated tutorial system and merging text from components.xml into the English localization files so more of the game is translatable for 1.17.

[b]Stable build will be updated to 1.15.0.1 next week. So if you are stable build please finish your games ASAP, so you don't QQ when you have to start over. You could also disable autoupdates if this is not an option.[/b]

1.15.1 Change Log
-Fill Research Staff now works on research teams.
-Fixed engine transverse. (Length and width now flip.)
-Fixed bug in fuel mileage testing and performance testing that resulted in worse stats due to mathematical error when all other siders were zeroed out.
-Fixed text errors on Replace Model tool.

notes.content:
We've finally hit another major milestone release. 1.15 has been launched on the [b]Default Branch[/b]. [i](Stable Branch is still on 1.14.8 for at least a week or two)[/i]

If you have auto update enabled, you've already received most of the content created for 1.15. This is because I believe a rolling release system is better for you and me instead of dumping everything into one big patch at a time.

The major goal for 1.15 was implementing the decal system. This new system allows us to do modern headlights and taillights as well as other items such as grills. [i](When our artist gets around to making them.)[/i]

The decal system is still a little buggy, specially on some body's due to poor shaping. We'll hopefully be replacing these car bodies overtime with better ones. Also auto mirror doesn't work on decals. I believe I can fix that for 1.15.1 


So what's next?
I will begin working on 1.16 tomorrow. We have three main goals for 1.16:

 [b]1) Linux port.[/b] While most of you own the game on Windows, the Linux port should help fix crash issues caused by poor video drivers as well fix the OpenGL renderer for many video cards. This hopefully means the game will become more stable.

[b]2) Tutorial System[/b] I wanted to avoid a text tutorial system in favor of a video system. However, during our Steam Launched I learned quite a bit about how Steam handles UAC on windows... It was a huge failure and got me a lot of bad press. So rather than being innovative, I'll go to the more traditional route of having an in game text based tutorial. Most of the tutorial will come from the 1.12 Manual and all parts should be accessible in game.

[b]3) Revised Racing System[/b] The racing system has needed some TLC for a long while. So I'll be fixing it up, cleaning it up, and filling it up. So if you have any ideas or suggestions for the racing system, I'd advise you to put them in writing within the next week or so.

I'll also be doing minor user suggestions, bugs, and performance optimizations as always. So it's not just those three big features. ;)

Since I am back to working on GC full time, 1.16 should be finished much quicker than 1.15 was.

Thank you all again for playing, I hope you enjoy it!

notes.content:
It's time for another update. Default branch has been moved up to 1.14.9

Luckily for most of you, 1.14.9 should still work with old save games, and any game made in 1.14.9 should work in 1.15. However 1.14.9 does not have the artwork for the new decal system in 1.15. That being said, save games from 1.14.8 will not work in 1.15. So you may want to finish those games ASAP before 1.15 comes out or move to the "Stable" branch.

In other news my Summer Teaching job is over, so I am back to working on GearCity full time. This means we should have faster bug fixes and more suggestions added each week! :)

I start working on 1.15 after lunch, it should be finished within a week (maybe less) so stay tuned!

1.14.7 Has been launched and is ready for your consumption. It includes commonly suggested features from the community. Although I still have many more things to add! 

We've also launched a new branch called "Stable" if you have save games and do not want them to break due to our frequent updates. Please use the "Stable" branch. I will be sure to give warnings before any patch that will cause save games to break.

That being said the Auto Production and Auto Retool feature will not save if you are using an old save game. They should however remember their selection status when you start a new game.

Auto Production still has some kinks and bugs to work out. So let me know how you like it?


1.14.8 I will hopefully finish the decal system so that our artist can get some decals made by the 1.15 release. Should also tackle some balancing issues and minor bugs and suggestions as always. 

Hope you enjoy! Here is the change log:
-Mouse Scrolling
-Auto Production
-Auto Retool
-Suggested Sell Price for new models
-Mouse over clickables in office changes the "tip" text to explain what you're moused over
-In game Video Settings will now only show supported resolutions for your monitor!
-Simulate more than one turn at a time.
-Manual entry of buy/sell stock shares.

Since this is our first major balancing of the late game, let us know how it feels! Feedback is much appreciated.

Thank you much and enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.14.4
notes.content:
Latest update is out!
It may look like a big update, but it's not. In fact, the game should be 400mb smaller! So what did I do since the last update?



[b]-Wrote a video settings resetting program[/b]
[i]This should allow you to reset the video settings if you break something. You can also enter custom resolutions. It is still recommended to use the in game video settings editor until I expand on this program's features.[/i]

[b]-Fixed engine and gearbox ratings[/b]
[i]Should be able to make higher rated engines and gearboxes now, which will also increase your performance and other ratings in vehicles.[/i]

[b]-Possible fix to office glow crash.[/b]
[i]Possible crash fix, although seems like there is some residue from clicking an item[/i]

[b]-Converted office tga's to dds. Possible crash fix.[/b]
[i]This reduces the game's install size by 400mb, vram usage by 50mb-ish, and reduced the usage of freeimage lib (which does have a few stability issues.) On top of that it may fix one of the office crash bugs, but that remains to be tested.[/i]

[b]-Fixed office crash in Linux Build.[/b]
[i] This is what spawned the above fix. You guys won't see this yet though. Becuase I still have a few more things to do to the Linux build.[/i]

[b]-Accessory placement by just clicking! [/b]
[i]The big feature of the week. You can now click exactly where you want to place Parts/Tires/Accessories. Simply choose the "Click Placement" method on the right, click the object you wish to place, then click where you want to place it... In a patch or two I will probably make this feature default.[/i]


As always, let me know if you have any issues, and enjoy!

-Possible fix to office glow crash.

-Fixed office crash in Linux Build.

I will continue working on late game balancing and designer crashes for the rest of the week.

Enjoy, and let me know if you have any issues or suggestions!

-Fixed World Map glows missing in 1980
-Fixed aerodynamic calculation crash
-Fixed multiple crashes with the accessories directional panel after you hit "finish" in the designer. 
-New 1940s door handle,
-Fixed new component design skill bug.

Here is what is included in this update:
-Fixed End key bug.
-Fixed fuel testing bug!
-Fixed a major bug in the production system that showed the wrong amount of employees
-Fixed bug is display of research team funding
-Tweaked AI's vehicle's aerodynamic drag values
-Fix missing text in unoptimized memos
-Changed wording of Production Line Quality, to Production Optimization.
-Changed MOTD, to tell you that video tutorials are available in the Steam Guides.
-Fixed GDR' per capitas 1950-2020


We'll continue working on bug fixes and minor suggestions this week, before we move on to gameplay balancing.

Thank you, and enjoy!
